name: Takashiro Masumi
source:
Maya Takashiro's younger brother.

He is a siscon who cares about his sister's happiness. He is honest and kind, considerate of those around him, but also firm in expressing his own opinions.

He is not a virgin because he had a girlfriend in the past.
He was dating a woman who resembled his sister.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/BeginnersQueen/]official site[/url]]
